plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid 50% of your value. While this isn't always optimal against predictable opponents, with only one round and unknown opponents, it's the safest approach to avoid significant losses. My value is $3, so 50% is $1.50. I will bid $1.50. This minimizes the risk of overpaying and maximizes my expected value given the limited information.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid 50% of my value. This is because my profit is (value - second highest bid) if I win, and 0 if I lose. Bidding 50% minimizes the risk of overpaying while still giving me a good chance of winning if my value is higher than others. My value is $24, so 50% is $12.
